node.label: Elevated urine trihydroxycholestanoic acid level
node.definition: Presence of trihydroxycholestanoic acid in the urine. Trihydroxycholestanoic acid is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of cholic acid. Elevated plasma levels of trihydroxycholestanoic acid have been found in patients with Zellweger syndrome.

evidence.snippet: Peroxisome biogenesis disorder 3B: Elevated urine trihydroxycholestanoic acid level [TAS]
